title: Research
text: My research lies at the intersection of Bayesian statistics, Bayesian nonparametrics, network modeling, and computational statistics. I develop flexible Bayesian methods for modeling complex and structured data, with a particular focus on heterogeneous populations, dependent structures, and scalable computational approaches.
